name: DreamGaussian
definition: A 2-stage text-to-3D method: (1) SDS-optimize Gaussians from a generated image; (2) refine via UV-texture diffusion. Generates a textured mesh in 2 minutes.
summary: DreamGaussian is a text-to-3D method using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SDS loss to generate high-quality textured meshes in about two minutes.
